purpose: Compare the previous Design profile and candidate operating system under identical conditions before activation.

briefs.prompt: Improve an ambiguous destructive settings label without changing navigation, data behavior, or the component family.
Improve the readability and hierarchy of an existing summary card while preserving its content, interaction, and system component semantics.
Design search for a personal content library with recent searches, suggestions, filters, zero results, retry, and keyboard behavior.
Design a multi-item import flow that communicates progress, partial success, duplicates, cancellation, and retry without losing completed work.
Design onboarding for a local-first app that requests photo access only when needed and preserves a useful path after denial or limited access.
Design an AI-assisted bulk action that explains uncertainty, lets people review and edit proposals, prevents accidental destructive execution, and supports undo and recovery.

shared_conditions: Use the same input brief, product facts, target platform, time limit and tool-call budget for baseline and candidate.
Do not expose candidate identity, implementation order, skill name or expected winner to the reviewer.
Store raw outputs and their SHA-256 hashes before scoring.
Score observable artifacts and decisions, not prose polish or prompt similarity.

activation_thresholds.hard_dimensions: candidate score must be greater than or equal to baseline for every brief
activation_thresholds.tie_or_inconclusive: fail activation and request another independent review

activation_rule: Pass only when every hard dimension is no-regression, at least four of six briefs improve, weighted aggregate gain is at least 0.2 on the five-point scale, and no review is inconclusive.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic paired evaluation measures contract behavior only and is not proof of real-user task success, satisfaction, retention, trust, or accessibility conformance.
